h1: Custom Full Color Lanyards for Events & Teams
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Lanyards | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color lanyards with your logo. Dye sublimation delivers vibrant, all-over prints. Perfect for events. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Full color lanyards let you print logos, photos, or gradient designs across the entire surface with no color limits. Unlike standard one- or two-color screen printing, dye sublimation on polyester or satin webbing produces photo-quality images that won't crack or fade. Trade show coordinators use them for attendee badges, while HR teams order them for employee ID cards with complex company branding. Options include breakaway safety buckles, retractable badge reels, and metal or plastic attachments.
heroAltText: Stack of custom full color lanyards with printed logos and various attachment styles
